title: SCPCraft
body:
# Features
---
**Implements [SCP-005](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-005):**
SCP-005 is a copper key that looks like any other. Its anomolous trait is that it can morph itself to work on any lock! Right click an iron door while holding it, and it'll open with no redstone required!

**Implements [SCP-009](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-009):**
SCP-009 looks like an ice block, but takes on a deep red hue. When an instance of SCP-009 is placed next to any aqueous blocks (Water, Ice, Packed Ice, Blue Ice, Snow, Snow Block, Powdered Snow), it'll start to slowly spread itself across them.

**Implements [SCP-173](https://scp-wiki.wikidot.com/scp-173):** 
SCP-173 is a statue constructed from stone and iron with traces of Krylon brand dye. SCP-173 is animate and extremely hostile. It cannot move when in direct line of sight, but if line of sight is broken it will move at high speeds towards a nearby player and kill them instantly. It appears that SCP-173 is invulnerable to most forms of damage, so if an instance is in the area, aviod it at all costs.

# FAQ
---
**Does this need to be installed on the server?**
Yes, if on a multiplayer server this mod needs to be installed on both the client and the server.

**How do I get SCP-005 and SCP-009?**
Both these SCPs are craftable, with there recipes shown in the gallery.

**Where does SCP-173 spawn?**
SCP-173 should rarely spawn anywhere in the overworld, but if for whatever reason it is not spawning for you, you can run the command /summon scpcraft:scp173
